art.title: The chart is already open.
art.body: Client history, birth data, natal chart and current transits on one screen — so you stop switching between a calendar, a notebook and a chart program three minutes before a consultation.

register.practiceHint: How clients will know your practice. You can change it later.
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Passwords found in known data breaches are refused.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.sub: We'll email you a link to choose a new one.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. Please sign in.

verify.title: Confirm your email address

verify.resent: A new link is on its way.
verify.failed: This link is invalid or has expired.

profile.title: My profile

profile.emailChanged: Profile saved. Check your inbox to confirm the new address.

practice.title: Practice
practice.nameHint: Shown in the app and, later, on booking pages and the client portal.

chart.title: Chart defaults

exact.label: Exact
exact.hint: Full chart: planets, angles, houses and aspects.

rectified.label: Rectified
rectified.hint: Full chart, marked as a rectified time.

approximate.label: Approximate
approximate.hint: Full chart, with a warning that angles and houses are unreliable.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.hint: Planets only, for 12:00 UT. No angles or houses; the Moon is shown as a range.

clients.title: Clients
clients.sub: Everyone you work with, and their birth data.

filters.search: Search by name, email or phone

clients.empty: No clients yet. Add the first one to see their birth data here.

form.languageHint: For your messages to the client; separate from your own interface language.
form.methodsHint: The methods you use with this client.
form.tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
form.notesHint: Only you see these. Never shared with the client.

birth.title: Birth data
birth.placePlaceholder: Start typing a town or city
birth.noPlaces: No place found. You can enter the coordinates by hand.
birth.dataSourceHint: e.g. birth certificate, client’s memory, family record

profile.chartSoon: The natal chart arrives with the astrology module.

missing.title: Before a chart can be calculated:
missing.birth_time: the time of birth (or mark it as unknown)
missing.location: the place of birth, with coordinates
missing.timezone: the time zone of the birth place

warnings.skipped: This time did not exist: clocks went forward that night. Check the time, or whether the record used the old time.
warnings.ambiguous: This time happened twice: clocks went back that night. Check which of the two moments is meant.
warnings.zoneHistory: Time-zone records before 1970 are unreliable in some regions. Check the offset if the chart looks wrong.
warnings.approximate: The birth time is approximate, so angles and houses will be unreliable.

chart.unavailable: Charts cannot be calculated right now. Everything else keeps working.
chart.moonRange: Time unknown: the Moon moved through this span during the birth date.
